## Environment

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `TOOL_HOME` | the home directory \| the default |

## tool pack

pack the source file into one archive

```text
usage: tool pack [flags] <src>

pack the source file into one archive

arguments:
  <src>  the source file

flags:
  -o <file>      write to <file> (default out.txt)
  -v, --verbose  print every step

environment:
  TOOL_HOME  the home directory | the default
```

Effects: `io, panic, nondet`

## tool count
